description: Co-simulates generation, conversion, storage, and demand as one system.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Integrated Energy-System Simulation Platform, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Multi-carrier network modeling). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Multi-carrier network modeling and Capacity-expansion and unit-commitment optimization. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Power-grid stability simulator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
